strengths.item: The paper is broadly organized in a conventional and easy-to-follow structure: introduction, related work, method formulation, architecture/training details, experiments, limitations, conclusion, and appendix.
Most equations are centered, numbered, and readable, and the method sections appear logically connected to the architecture figures.

Several main figures and tables are inspectable: Figure 1 and Figure 2 are informative overall, Figure 3 is visually clear, Table 1 is dense but mostly legible, and the appendix is organized into clear subsections.
Captions for some figures, especially Figure 1, Figure 2, and appendix Figure 7, provide useful explanatory context.

weaknesses.item: The PDF contains conspicuous draft-like formatting artifacts, including large blocks of blue/orange colored text and a red strikethrough sentence, which makes the submission look unfinished and distracts from the content.

Several figures and tables require zooming or are cramped: internal labels in Figure 1 and Figure 2 are small, Figure 4 has small plot/legend/axis text, Table 1 is very dense, and Table 4 appears poorly spaced with task names and success values running together.
The real-world results presentation is weak: Figure 5 has a terse caption that does not explain the visual evidence well, and nearby labels appear awkwardly phrased or broken.

There are noticeable proofreading and formatting errors in later sections, including missing spaces, typos, inconsistent capitalization, and awkward phrases such as “test out model” and “exiting future direction.”

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The PDF inspection found that the paper is generally readable and follows an ICLR-style layout, with clear sectioning and mostly readable equations. However, page-level evidence shows substantial presentation issues: Page 3 contains large colored paragraphs resembling revision markup; Page 4 includes a red strikethrough sentence below Figure 2; Pages 8–9 contain dense or cramped result tables and small figure labels; Page 9’s Table 4 text appears run together, and Figure 5 has an under-informative caption. The limitations/conclusion page also contains several proofreading and spacing artifacts. The appendix is more orderly, with Figure 7 having a useful caption, though Figure 6’s caption is minimal.
dimension_review.rationale: The paper is understandable and organized well enough for a reviewer to follow the main method and empirical results, but the number and severity of formatting, captioning, figure/table legibility, and proofreading issues go beyond minor polish problems. The colored text, strikethrough artifact, cramped real-world table, and under-explained real-world visualization make parts of the paper harder to inspect and verify. Thus, the presentation is fair rather than good.
